title: A sprint goal clause about 'the open findings' reads every open finding of that kind at review, not the planning-day snapshot of ids
goal: a check for a goal clause that names the open findings of a kind reads querylog.py show --findings --kind KIND --state open in full, or the clause names the day of its snapshot, so findings filed after planning (F-0087f0a19e8b, F-164e39b14bfc, F-543547c9270c in SP-vx6eufpj) do not leave a clause unmet while its checks pass

run: import sys;s=open('.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md').read();i=s.find('## plan');b=s[i:s.find('## start',i)];sys.exit(0 if 'snapshot' in b else 1)
